raw_response:
This plot is only 0.29 hectares and I am renting it, so I will not buy chemical fertilizer that costs too much for land that is not mine. I will spread the poultry manure I have saved behind my house because it is free and it helps my tubers grow bigger. I will plant cassava cuttings and yam setts from my own harvest last year since improved seed from the agro-dealer is too expensive for this small rented place. My sons and grandchildren will do the heavy work with me, so we do not need to pay for outside labor.
